description:
Version-independent Morphe patch for the official SD Maid SE FOSS APK (`eu.darken.sdmse`).

The bundle was built and applied to the official v2.2.2-rc0 APK using Morphe Desktop 1.18.1. The injected bytecode was verified. The structural anchor also passed on v2.1.0-rc0, v2.2.0-rc0, and v2.2.1-rc0. Future versions are accepted while this entitlement structure remains; GitHub Actions runs a daily patching check.

Download `patches-0.1.0.mpp` below and select **Unlock Pro (FOSS)** in Morphe. Release asset SHA-256: `49283160e200bb6bfad014b2dac735e83bfc07eac8d5a28baf3a669496a378f4`.

Android device installation and feature behavior have not been tested.
